content: Black Friday seems to get earlier and earlier every year. A week before the main festivities, Sega has launched its Black Friday 2026 sale, featuring discounts of up to 80% on certain titles. The sale is running across the Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Steam, and Xbox — and it includes Sega and Atlus franchises such as Sonic the Hedgehog, Persona, and Like A Dragon.
